title: Inspired by the Netflix movie The Platform
author: Injusticeee
selftext:
Please try out my game Down To Die and give it an upvote if you enjoy! Its a 20 person battle royale. 3-5 minutes per match, online multiplayer or offline with clever bots, open mic to make friends or enemies.

Grab a pillow to protect yourself and take apart your bed for coverage.

Is waking up on the first or the 10th floor the bigger advantage? Let me know!

I built the game with Claude Opus 5.5 and upgraded the character models slightly once Fable 5.2 dropped.

[https://app.base44.com/launchpad/down-to-die](https://app.base44.com/launchpad/down-to-die)

comments.author: Outrageous_Tooth856
comments.body: Cool idea. Always wondered about a setup like this after watching the movie. Any tips for anyone who wants to experiment with Battle Royale style modes?

replies.author: Injusticeee
replies.body: I think the biggest thing aside from solid gameplay is sneaking in small social features. I did that by putting a jukebox on each floor that anyone can change the music of, allowing players to truce with a handshake, and made open mic communication so folks could chat in a match.
